d:
A doujin about Lamia by HyperweaveFC and 空气泡Air.
Based on PGR's chapter 26.
Note: the English version is the original version and it is uncensored.
This is HyperweaveFC and 空气泡Air's work.

At the time of this writing, the only available source is here (censored due to Pixiv rules): https://www.pixiv.net/en/artworks/148716124

The resolution is pretty high for a comic, though you might not notice this unless you download it.

Please archive the doujin elsewhere just in case so that it is not lost. Thanks.

Edit: If it's not clear, this site was the first place it was uploaded to. I also go by "HyperweaveFC" and am the source. I am intending to let it be translated into Chinese at some point, too.

This project was extremely difficult for us both, so please leave a comment in support if you enjoyed it.
